intro: There are 11 playable races in Baldur's Gate 3 . Many playable races are divided into subraces , which further defines a character's strengths, abilities, and appearance. Refer to individual Race pages for further details. Unless otherwise noted, spells gained from race may only be cast once per Long Rest. In D&D 5e, playable races tend to receive fixed ability score bonuses as racial bonuses. Baldur's Gate 3 instead awards each race the following ability score bonuses for the player to freely allocate: +2 to any Ability Score +1 to any other Ability Score
size: Halflings and Gnomes are Small; all other playable races are Medium.
